news.title: ‘Bubbly ray of light:’ Marietta community mourns 7-year-old killed in crash
news.summary: A 7-year-old girl who “impacted the lives of everyone” is being mourned by her family, classmates and the Marietta community after she was killed in a crash earlier this week.

news.title: Georgia school shooting plot: Superintendent says school floor plans weren’t accessed

news.title: 1 killed, 1 injured in I-285 crash

news.title: 3 people escape East Point house fire, 1 injured
